papers.title: Health dynamics and reporting bias at retirement: An analysis using high-frequency data.
papers.abstract: We introduce a novel approach to identify state-dependent reporting bias in subjective health measures. The central idea is that health operates as a stock, making abrupt shifts in self-reported health (SRH) following retirement more likely to reflect reporting bias than actual changes. To capture such shifts, our analysis integrates three key elements: (1) differentiating stock and flow outcomes based on classical health theory; (2) leveraging an identification strategy inspired by regression discontinuity design; and (3) exploiting a unique high-frequency dataset on monthly health and retirement. Traditional estimates find a decline in SRH after retirement over longer periods; however, this decline steadily diminishes as the observation window narrows, showing no evidence of state-dependent reporting bias. Our analysis of short-term health dynamics also emphasizes distinguishing stock and flow health outcomes in policy evaluations.
papers.summary: 本研究提出了一種新方法來識別主觀健康衡量指標中的狀態依存報告偏差。研究基於健康作為「存量」的理論，利用高頻率的月度健康與退休數據，並結合迴歸不連續設計的識別策略，觀察退休前後主觀健康（SRH）的急劇變化。結果顯示，傳統長期估計中退休後SRH下降的現象，會隨著觀察窗口縮短而逐漸消失，並未發現狀態依存的報告偏差。
papers.significance: 此研究挑戰了過去認為退休會導致主觀健康評估產生報告偏差的傳統觀點，證實了退休後短期內的健康動態並未受到報告偏差的干擾。這強調了在健康政策評估中，必須精確區分「存量」與「流量」健康結果的重要性，為未來使用主觀健康數據進行勞動與健康經濟研究提供了更可靠的實證方法與理論基礎。

papers.title: Assessing connection to outpatient care among patients screening positive for previously undiagnosed diabetes in the emergency department: a combined retrospective cohort and prospective cohort survey study.
papers.abstract: Patients with frequent emergency department (ED) use often have poor connection to primary care, limiting access to preventive screening. Screening patients at risk for diabetes is essential to ensure early treatment via medication and lifestyle changes. While ED screening programs have shown success in diagnosing diabetes, it is unknown the impact on follow-up with subsequent care, and thus downstream patient outcomes. This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy of an emergency department (ED)-based diabetes screening program, assessing follow-up for subsequent management, if patients changed health behaviors or initiated medications, and barriers reported to follow-up if patients did not establish care. Screening results and patient data from four ED sites of a health system were retrospectively collected; we then performed a phone-based survey of all patients diagnosed with diabetes via ED screening over one year. Patients were queried about diagnosis awareness, connection to follow-up or barriers to establishing care, and health behavior changes (diet, exercise, medications). Of 9,897 screened ED patients, 615 (6.2%) had diabetes. We surveyed 307 patients (50% response rate). Among newly diagnosed patients; 79% reported obtaining outpatient care, but only 46% recalled ED diagnosis. Health behavior changes included 65% reporting diet improvement, 35% increasing exercise, and 52% starting diabetes medication. Patients who failed to follow-up reported barriers including awareness of screening result, time/scheduling issues, and financial considerations. This study assesses the reported rate of outpatient care following diabetes diagnosis via an ED screening program and identifies barriers experienced by patients who did not obtain follow-up. Improved connections between screening programs and subsequent care are needed to improve outcomes.
papers.summary: 本研究評估了急診室（ED）基礎糖尿病篩檢項目的成效及其後續門診連接情況。在9,897名受篩檢的急診患者中，有615人（6.2%）被診斷出糖尿病。針對307名患者的調查顯示，新確診患者中有79%獲得了門診護理，但僅有46%記得急診的診斷結果。在健康行為改變方面，65%改善了飲食，35%增加了運動，52%開始服用糖尿病藥物。未進行後續追蹤的患者報告的主要障礙包括不知曉篩檢結果、時間與排程問題以及財務考量。
papers.significance: 此研究突顯了雖然急診室篩檢能有效發現未確診的糖尿病患者，但患者對診斷結果的認知不足以及後續轉介門診的障礙限制了其長期效益。改善篩檢項目與後續初級保健之間的無縫銜接，對於提升患者健康行為改變率、藥物遵從性及整體治療結果具有重要意義，這也為醫療體系優化急診轉診流程與資源配置提供了實證基礎。

papers.title: "But they are hard work": A qualitative study of the perceptions of healthcare workers in providing care to persons with disabilities in Uganda.
papers.abstract: Healthcare workers play a central role in providing and facilitating access to healthcare for all. However, gaps in knowledge, training, and experience in disability care can limit their ability to provide inclusive care. Exploring healthcare workers' perceptions and experiences is crucial for informing the development of disability-inclusive healthcare services that are accessible, responsive, and equitable. We conducted qualitative interviews with healthcare workers (n = 13) in Luuka district, Uganda, between September and November 2022. Interviews explored healthcare workers' perceptions and experiences in providing healthcare to persons with disabilities. Participants included nurses (n = 3), midwives (n = 2), laboratory technicians (n = 2), and clinical officers (n = 6). We also conducted key informant interviews (n = 4) with representatives from Luuka district health officials (n = 2) and the Ugandan Ministry of Health (n = 2). The interviews were audio-recorded and transcribed, and then thematically analysed. We adapted Andersen's Behavioural Model to focus on healthcare provision. We focused on five (5) themes: (1) knowledge and perceptions of disability, (2) perceived enabling factors, (3) perceived needs and demands for inclusive care provision, (4) systemic and structural factors, and (5) quality and inclusiveness of care. Across the themes, limited knowledge of disability, poor understanding of healthcare needs, inadequate treatment of disability-related illnesses, and negative attitudes towards persons with disabilities constrained the provision of inclusive care. These challenges were compounded by the limited availability of inclusive environments and services, which restricted healthcare workers' ability to care for people with disabilities. There is an urgent need to invest in building the knowledge, skills, and confidence of healthcare workers to provide inclusive and respectful care for persons with disabilities. Integrating disability awareness and inclusive care into pre-service and in-service training, improving facility accessibility, and fostering supportive work environments are essential steps toward achieving inclusive health systems. By translating these insights into action, Uganda can move closer to realising its commitment to universal health coverage and the right to health for all.
papers.summary: 本質性研究探討了烏干達盧伊卡地區醫療保健人員在為身心障礙者提供醫療服務時的認知與經驗。研究透過訪談13名醫護人員與4名衛生官員，發現醫護人員普遍缺乏對身心障礙的足夠知識、對醫療需求理解不足、存在負面態度，且對相關疾病的治療不當。此外，缺乏包容性的醫療環境與服務進一步限制了醫護人員提供完善照護的能力，顯示出現行醫療體系在落實障礙包容性照護上面臨嚴峻挑戰。
papers.significance: 此研究突顯了在資源受限地區實現全民健康覆蓋的關鍵障礙，為烏干達及類似開發中國家優化身心障礙醫療政策提供了實證基礎。研究結果強調，將障礙意識與包容性照護納入醫事人員職前與在職培訓、改善醫療設施的無障礙環境，以及創造支持性的職場氛圍，是推動包容性醫療體系不可或缺的步驟，對保障弱勢群體的健康權益具有重要指標意義。

papers.title: Uncovering diagnostic errors in dentistry through critical incident reports: a mixed-methods analysis.
papers.abstract: Diagnostic errors and near misses threaten patient safety in dental practice. In Sindh, the service delivery standards require documentation and review of critical incidents, supporting incident reporting as a platform for ensuring patient safety. This study aimed to describe incident patterns using critical incident reports, a structured patient safety reporting mechanism used to document adverse events, near misses, and diagnostic process failures in clinical practice. A sequential mixed-methods study reviewed 300 de-identified incident reports from Karachi from January to June 2024. Associations with urgency were assessed using chi-square or Fisher's exact tests and logistic regression analysis. Reflexive thematic analysis of narrative fields was supplemented by face-to-face interviews with 20 selected reporters. Incidents were classified as urgent in 173/300 (57.7%) cases, and corrective action was required in 289/300 (96.3%) cases. Recurrence was most commonly coded as 20-40% (148/300, 49.3%). The most frequently coded diagnostic domains were pulp diseases (87/300, 29.0%), periodontal ligament diseases (85/300, 28.3%), and temporomandibular joint disorders (80/300, 26.7%). The leading contributing factors were a lack of diagnostic resources (142/300, 47.3%), lack of postgraduate training (119/300, 39.7%), and gaps in undergraduate teaching (103/300, 34.3%). Recurrence category showed the strongest association with urgency (p < 0.001). In multivariable logistic regression, urgent classification was less likely in private clinics (aOR 0.16, p = 0.013) and among male reporters (aOR 0.37, p < 0.001) and more likely in reports filed by senior faculty (aOR 2.48, p = 0.025); the 20-29 patients/week group also had higher adjusted odds of urgency (aOR 2.26, p = 0.023). Qualitative themes highlighted incomplete assessments, limited access to and interpretation of imaging, gaps in supervision and referral pathways, and communication failures. The registry demonstrates recurrent, high-urgency patterns linked to resource and training constraints and supports structured critical incident reporting as a practical tool for teaching triage, escalation, and safer diagnostic workflows for safer and more effective dental care. Not applicable.
papers.summary: 本研究透過分析巴基斯坦卡拉奇2024年上半年的300份牙科重大事件報告，探討牙科診斷錯誤與差點出錯的型態。研究發現，超過半數（57.7%）的事件被列為緊急，且高達96.3%需要採取糾正措施。最常發生診斷錯誤的領域為牙髓病、牙周韌帶病及顳顎關節疾病；而主要導致錯誤的因素包括診斷資源不足、缺乏研究生培訓及大學部教學缺口。質性分析進一步指出，不完整的評估、影像學資源受限與解讀困難、監督與轉診機制不全，以及溝通不良是關鍵問題。
papers.significance: 此研究凸顯了結構化重大事件報告系統在提升牙科診斷安全方面的實用價值。透過量化與質性分析的結合，研究不僅具體指出資源與培訓限制對高緊急度診斷錯誤的顯著影響，更證明了該報告機制能作為教學分診、危機升級與優化診斷流程的有效工具，為未來制定更安全且有效的牙科臨床照護策略提供了實證基礎。

papers.title: Youth-friendly health services for tuberculosis care: an integrative review and implementation science synthesis.
papers.abstract: Adolescents and young adults (AYAs) face disproportionate risk of tuberculosis (TB) due to biological vulnerability, mobility, distinct risks for HIV infection and treatment failure, structural barriers, and limited access to adolescent-responsive care. Although the World Health Organization recommends youth-friendly health services (YFHS), implementation in TB care has received little attention. This review synthesizes current evidence on the application of YFHS principles across the TB care continuum to inform models responsive to the needs of AYAs. An integrative review was conducted using established methodology and included qualitative, quantitative, and conceptual studies of YFHS in TB care for individuals aged 10 to 24 years in high- and medium-burden countries. Searches were performed in four scientific databases. Two reviewers independently screened records, extracted data, and conducted quality appraisal using Joanna Briggs Institute tools. A deductive thematic synthesis was applied based on the five YFHS domains: for accessible, acceptable, equitable, appropriate, and effective care. Implementation gaps were examined using the integrated Promoting Action on Research Implementation in Health Services (i-PARIHS) framework. Of 6,067 records screened, 16 studies met inclusion criteria. Most focused on TB treatment, with limited attention to prevention or diagnosis. Strategies to improve accessibility included decentralized services, mobile health tools, and community-based models. Acceptability was related to respectful provider communication, youth-oriented spaces, and privacy protections to reduce stigma. Gaps in equitable care included restrictive consent laws and the absence of tailored services for vulnerable youth. Appropriateness emphasized the importance of integrated care and confidentiality, while effectiveness depended on staff training, clinical readiness, and prompt treatment initiation. Persistent implementation barriers included misaligned policies, fragmented service structures, and limited involvement of youth in service design. There is an urgent need for adolescent-responsive TB strategies that align service delivery with the preferences and realities of AYAs. Standardized YFHS indicators, meaningful youth engagement, and context-sensitive facilitation approaches are critical to guide implementation. Integrating YFHS principles into national TB programs-supported by dedicated facilitators, cross-sectoral collaboration, and strengthened health systems-has the potential to improve care engagement and outcomes for AYAs living with or at risk of TB.
papers.summary: 青少年與青年成人（AYA）面臨較高的結核病（TB）風險，但針對該群族的青年友善健康服務（YFHS）在TB照護中的實施顯不足。本整合性回顧納入16項研究，基於可及性、可接受性、公平性、適宜性與有效性五大領域進行分析。結果顯示，現有策略多聚焦於治療階段，透過去中心化服務、行動健康工具與社區模式提升可及性；尊嚴溝通、隱私保護與青年空間有助於提高可接受性。然而，在預防診斷、同意權法規、弱勢青年服務及青年參與設計等方面，仍存在顯著的實施障礙與公平性缺口。
papers.significance: 本研究系統性地填補了YFHS在結核病照護中應用的證據空白，突顯了當前政策與服務結構脫節的問題。透過提出將YFHS原則融入國家結核病計畫，並結合標準化指標、跨部門協作與青年參與的框架，為全球公共衛生決策者提供實踐藍圖，有助於改善感染或處於結核病風險中青少年的照護參與度與健康結果。

papers.title: Regional differences in the level of healthcare in China.
papers.abstract: Large inequities exist between different regions in China in terms of access to healthcare. However, there is limited quantitative research on these regional disparities. Therefore, we aimed to analyse the differences in the levels of healthcare in various regions of China, and to provide a reference for healthcare reform aimed at optimising the allocation of medical resources in China. We collected and organised healthcare-related data from China's provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government from 2012 to 2021 and selected 18 indicators related to medical services for the year 2021. We used factor analysis, cluster analysis, and the Theil and Atkinson index to quantitatively study the medical service levels of China's regions. There was a large discrepancy between regions in terms of the level of healthcare, with the lowest level of healthcare in economically underdeveloped regions. The distribution of medical resources in various regions of China is uneven, with a lack of medical resources in the western and central regions and underutilisation of medical resources in easten region. To rectify the imbalance in the level of healthcare services across China, health reform must focus on enhancing regional economic development. Strengthen the capacity of grassroots healthcare services and reduce inequalities in medical resource allocation. Moreover, future policies should focus more on addressing regional disparities in healthcare funding and urban-rural gaps in medical resource allocation.
papers.summary: 本研究收集2012至2021年中國各省級行政區的醫療數據，透過因子分析、聚類分析及泰爾指數等計量方法，量化分析2021年中國各區域的醫療服務水平。研究結果顯示，中國各區域醫療保健水平存在顯著落差，經濟欠發達地區醫療水平最低；中西部地區面臨醫療資源匱乏，而東部地區則出現資源利用不足的現象。
papers.significance: 此研究為中國醫療改革與優化醫療資源配置提供了重要的實證參考。其結果突顯了促進區域經濟發展對提升醫療水平的關鍵作用，並指導未來政策應著重於強化基層醫療服務能力、縮小醫療資金的地域差異，以及彌合城鄉醫療資源分配的鴻溝，進而推動醫療服務的公平性。

papers.title: Author Correction: Methodological considerations for evaluating policy impacts on transgender and non-binary youth suicidality.
papers.summary: 本文為《自然-人類行為》期刊先前發表之關於評估政策對跨性別與非二元性別青少年自殺傾向影響之論文的作者更正。主要針對該研究在方法學考量上的瑕疵或誤漏進行修正與補充說明，以確保研究方法的嚴謹性與準確性。
papers.significance: 此更正確保了關於跨性別與非二元性別青少年自殺傾向之政策評估研究的學術準確性。由於該議題涉及脆弱群體的心理健康與公共政策的制定，方法學的嚴謹性至關重要，有助於避免研究誤解對未來政策制定與社會大眾認知產生負面影響。

papers.title: Decriminalizing same-sex relationships and its impact on social media discussions in Asia.
papers.abstract: While legal reforms may coincide with shifts in public discourse, broader normative change often remains uneven and context dependent. Since 2018, four Asian countries-India, Taiwan, Thailand and Singapore-have decriminalized same-sex relationships, providing an opportunity to examine how such institutional changes are associated with public discussions of LGBTQ+ topics. Here, using supervised and unsupervised natural language processing methods, we analysed 136,255 Facebook news posts and 65,969 public Instagram captions within a 100-day window before and after each reform. To contextualize online discourse with offline sentiment, we incorporated nationally representative survey data from the Gallup World Poll (N = 46,200). Following decriminalization, online discussions were characterized by reduced moralized and affectively negative language, particularly in contexts with greater freedom of expression. By contrast, offline perceptions of neighbourhood safety for same-sex couples shifted more modestly and unevenly across age groups and countries.
